differences.what: A's horn on top is smeared and distorted: the waveguide flare reads as a dark painterly blur, and the bezel edge wobbles. B's horn is crisp, with a clean rounded-rectangle bezel, a readable throat and a specular rim on the rear dome
A's woofer is a mushy blue-grey disc with no cone, surround or dust cap structure. B's woofer shows a defined surround, cone and cap under the clear front
A's cabinet edges are soft and uneven, and its panel lines drift. B holds straight, sharp edges, a legible slot port and the lower port rings through the translucent shell
A's base is muddied by lumpy rocks and a dark tangle of debris that merges with the cabinet, so the product has no clean footprint. B sits cleanly on the ground with a believable contact shadow
A's background has artefacts that pull the eye: a ghostly half-formed figure at upper right and a glowing ember pile beside it. B's background is coherent receding trunks in haze

A's haze is blown toward white and flattens the product into a low-contrast silhouette. B keeps the haze and god rays while the product holds tonal separation, though it is still underlit and slightly muddy on the front face
A's foreground has more storytelling texture (ferns, twigs, long raking shadows), but it reads as an AI-smoothed photo. B's soil is plausible though repetitive and dark
